spanish: Siete días panes ázimos comerán; solo en el día primero harán cesar levadura de sus casas, porque todo comiente leudado, y será cortada esa alma de Israel, desde día primero hasta día séptimo.

findings.issue: חָמֵץ is a masculine singular noun, the thing eaten by the participle אֹכֵל; “comiente leudado” treats leudado as an adjective of the eater, so the eater is leavened and the eaten thing is not named.
אַךְ is marked only as an affirmation particle; “solo” narrows it to exclusivity.
Both ordinals are definite; Spanish drops the article on the closing “first” and “seventh.”

notes: 2mp comerán/harán/sus is ustedes address; niphal será cortada and esa alma match the 3fs.
